dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Kazoo, a lovable goofball with a big heart!

Kazoo is happiest soaking up attention from his people. Whether he’s snuggling on the couch, enjoying a relaxing massage or stretching himself across your lap, this affectionate guy knows how to make the most of cuddle time!

When he’s not busy collecting pets, Kazoo enjoys sniffy walks, playing with dog friends and spending time playing with his favorite toys. His silly side comes out in happy wiggles, big smiles and the occasional adorable snort.

Looking for a companion who enjoys both playtime and quiet moments together? Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Kazoo’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: KAZOO
